findings.title: Location setup dialog recurs and blocks every route crawl
steps: complete onboarding
dismiss location setup
navigate to another route with production runtime bridge
repeat across 52 routes
findings.expected: First-launch location sheet closes permanently for the session after Not now or Close.
findings.actual: The dialog reopened/remained visible after route state changes; runtime-393.json records dialogCount=1 for all 52 routes.

findings.title: Routes are not addressable by source deep link or refresh
steps: navigate runtime state
refresh/inspect location.href
findings.expected: Each route has a refreshable deep-link URL.
findings.actual: location.href remained http://15.235.203.134:9998/; route state exists only in in-memory __NAVIGATE__.

findings.title: Console verification unavailable from target harness
steps: crawl routes and inspect exposed runtime errors
findings.expected: A readable console stream proves zero errors after navigation/interactions.
findings.actual: window.__consoleErrors was empty, but the harness did not expose the browser console stream; no console PASS claimed.
